signal_description: Historic MLB debut: three home runs in his first game, the first three-homer debut in major-league history.
headline: Historic debut creates an immediate attention shock
why_now: The debut is an acceleration event; the opportunity question is whether Bowman prices lagged the attention spike enough to leave a narrow entry window.
thesis: Joshua Baez has a nationally legible MLB catalyst. Monitor established Bowman prospect cards immediately, but authorize no capital action until authoritative post-event sold comps establish the actual repricing.
falsification: Post-debut sold comps show target cards already repriced beyond the chase threshold.
Follow-on playing time or performance does not sustain attention.
Target-card liquidity is too thin to establish a trustworthy entry level.

cards.rationale: Liquid, recognizable Bowman Chrome prospect expression; refresh sold comps before action.

cards.label: 2022 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-JB Joshua Baez
cards.rationale: Higher-conviction autograph expression; requires fresh post-catalyst price discovery.

signal_description: Twins prospect Kaelen Culpepper homered in his MLB debut after a midseason promotion into a playoff race.
headline: Debut homer turns a call-up into an early acceleration signal
why_now: Culpepper entered MLB as a top-30 prospect and immediately produced a simple hobby narrative: first-rounder, premium position, debut home run, playoff context.
thesis: Kaelen Culpepper has moved from prospect anticipation into early MLB validation. His 2024 Bowman Draft 1st Chrome and Chrome auto deserve immediate repricing checks before broader rookie-card attention arrives.
falsification: Authoritative sold comps show the Bowman market already fully repriced the debut catalyst.
Playing time falls materially after the initial promotion.
MLB production fails to sustain attention beyond the debut window.

cards.rationale: Primary 1st Bowman Chrome prospect expression with broad parallel depth.

cards.label: 2024 Bowman Draft Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-KC Kaelen Culpepper

signal_description: The Yankees promoted top prospect George Lombard Jr. to the majors and installed him at shortstop after declining to add one at the trade deadline.
headline: Yankees promotion creates a high-attention catalyst for a premium-position prospect
why_now: A Yankees starting-role promotion creates national visibility, but the card market was already carrying a prospect premium before the call-up, so the thesis requires especially strict repricing discipline.
thesis: George Lombard Jr. has a legitimate catalyst but may have less unpriced upside than a colder prospect because his 1st Bowman market was already expensive. Radar should verify whether the call-up created acceleration or merely confirmed consensus.
falsification: Authoritative sold comps show the call-up was fully anticipated and already priced.
He loses regular shortstop playing time.
The Yankees catalyst produces attention without incremental card-market demand.

cards.label: 2024 Bowman Draft Chrome BDC-118 George Lombard Jr.
cards.rationale: Established Bowman Chrome prospect expression; use repricing verification to distinguish catalyst from consensus.

cards.label: 2025 Bowman Chrome Mega Box Prospect Autograph BMAGL George Lombard Jr.
cards.rationale: Autograph expression with verified checklist identity; liquidity must be proven before action.

signal_description: Houston scratched Ethan Pecko from his scheduled Triple-A start while the club discusses using him for a possible MLB start this week.
headline: Possible Astros call-up is visible before the roster move
why_now: The Astros have unsettled rotation spots, Pecko was scratched from his scheduled Triple-A start, and the general manager publicly acknowledged a possible debut this week. That creates a pre-catalyst window before an official transaction or first MLB appearance.
thesis: Ethan Pecko is a genuine pre-catalyst Radar candidate rather than a post-breakout chase. His 2025 Bowman Chrome 1st prospect autograph can be monitored before a possible MLB debut, but no capital action is authorized until authoritative sold comps establish the current market and the call-up probability strengthens.
falsification: Houston announces a different starter and Pecko remains in Triple-A.
The rotation opportunity closes without an MLB promotion.
Authoritative sold comps show the prospect-auto market already repriced the call-up speculation beyond an attractive entry.

cards.label: 2025 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-EPE Ethan Pecko
cards.rationale: Verified 1st Bowman Chrome prospect autograph and the clearest hobby expression if a debut catalyst materializes.
